milestones.title: Same Line, Different Idea
milestones.when: shell: `git merge` or `git pull` exits non-zero and leaves a merge in progress

milestones.title: Diplomat
milestones.joke: Both records kept. Peace in our time.
milestones.when: shell: `git commit` that completes a merge (exit 0)

milestones.title: Preview First, Always
milestones.joke: Previewed the merge result before pushing.
milestones.when: shell: `dnscontrol preview` while the merge is still in progress (exit 0)
